title: Handy Voice Transcript
description: A versioned transcription session: recognized segments (tentative and confirmed), plus non-fatal errors. Field names schemaversion/sessionid follow the product specification; schema_version/session_id are accepted as aliases on read.

sessionid.description: Unique identifier for this recording session. Used as the upload idempotency key, so it must be stable for the life of the session.

updated_at.description: Last modification time, RFC 3339 UTC. Optional on read (defaults to created_at when absent); this exporter always writes it.

language.description: Language tag for the recognized speech, e.g. zh-TW, zh-Hant, en.

engine.description: Optional metadata about the engine that produced the text.

segments.description: Recognized text in recognition order. A segment is addressed by segment_id and replaced in place as its revision advances, so tentative and confirmed text are never both appended.

id.description: Dense 1-based display position, unique within the document.

segment_id.description: Stable identity, repeated across revisions of the same segment. Unique within the document. Optional on read: a document without it is ingested by using the display id. This exporter always writes it.

revision.description: Monotonic revision of this segment's text. Optional on read (defaults to 1); this exporter always writes it.

text.description: UTF-8 text for this revision. May legitimately be empty after a user edit.

final.description: True when the text is confirmed and will not change.

kind.description: Result kind. Optional on read; when absent it is derived from 'final'. When present it must agree with 'final'.

start_ms.description: Optional start offset in milliseconds. Not produced in the first phase.

end_ms.description: Optional end offset in milliseconds. Not produced in the first phase.

errors.description: Non-fatal failures recorded during the session. Never merged into segments.
